Work Breakdown Structure (WBS)

Instantly generate and print project hierarchies.

How it works
1. Enter the main Project Name.
2. List your main phases (Level 1) on new lines without hyphens.
3. Add one hyphen - for a Level 2 sub-task.
4. Add two hyphens -- for a Level 3 sub-sub-task.
5. Click Generate. Click the - / + buttons to collapse or expand branches.
